g.text: Original coastline interpretation after comparison with the official introductory map; no traced licensed coastline.
After: projecting headland and recessed bay
Mainland stays within the hard11,000x8,000 limit;58 sites and existing waters,relief,forests and roads are retained.

The current official illustration supports the broad silhouette cue; exact shore vertices and scale remain our interpretation.
